title: Red Allen teasing Higgenbotham
summary: When Red Allen joined, he constantly teased Higgenbotham about women; Holmes stayed out of it and Russell let them have fun.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yeah, it was just like a family. And when Red come in the band, him and Higgenbotham, oh brother... You wouldn't believe it. Boy, Red would make Higgy so mad! And his nose would swell up... Well, Higgy would be in tears. Red could make him that mad. 'Course, Red could make anybody mad. Red was...
He was a big teaser. He would tease hard, too. And I'm so glad I didn't get into none of that stuff.
I didn't play with any of them, you know. Red was pretty strong sometimes. And I seen him all over (?).
Well, what was he ribbing Higgy about?
Anything. Anything. Anything would do. Anything at all.
Because they were the best of friends, weren't they?
No, they weren't. No, no, no...

Well, I mean, you know... They were friends. I mean, they kidded and kidded and kidded... See, Higgy, he was a lover man. That's all he talked about. He was a Don Juan, this, that and the other. And that's what Red was always gettin' on him about -- different females, you know. But Higgy wasn't no different than nobody else, but he thought he was. And poor Red would... He'd get on him, too.

But they had a lot of fun between them. They'd sit up there and... Well, everybody in the band got kidded at some time or other, but some of them went a little strong sometimes. And poor Russell, he would just up there, and he wouldn't say nothing one way or the other. Just let them have a ball.
